steps.description: Given a desktop with an integrated and a discrete GPU, when the overlay reads its sensors, then it shows fan, CPU, GPU and RAM, with the discrete GPU.
Given sensors read without admin rights, when the overlay shows them, then the CPU temperature and power show as missing, not 0, and RAM is the real one, not virtual memory.
Given a value past its thresholds, when it is shown, then its meter turns yellow or red.
Given the config names a sensor for a metric, when the overlay reads, then it uses that sensor.
Given the service is not running, when the overlay paints, then every value shows as missing.
Given the service stays connected but stops sending, when 3 seconds pass, then the values show as missing.
Given a broken or newer config file, when it is read, then the defaults apply and the problem is reported.
Given garbage on the sensor pipe, when the overlay reads it, then nothing is shown from it and nothing crashes.
Given a sensor read that fails, when the service ticks, then the service ends with the error so Windows restarts it.
Given a client that stops reading, when the service writes, then that client is dropped and the others keep getting data.
Given another program created the pipe first, when the service starts, then it refuses to join it.
Given thermi installed, when the PC restarts and a person signs in, then the overlay is on the taskbar with live values and no UAC prompt.
Given the overlay on the taskbar, when a person clicks the taskbar, opens Start and searches, then the overlay stays visible on top.
Given the overlay was dragged somewhere, when the PC restarts, then it is in the same place.

Given the two tools thermi replaced shown beside it for a minute, when a person compares them, then the values agree and thermi looks the same: one pill per group, the same units and the same meter colors at the same values.

Given the settings file open in an editor, when a person changes a threshold and saves, then the overlay applies it; when the file has a typo, then the overlay shows that the settings are broken and the file keeps the person's text.
Given the service's process killed from Task Manager, when 10 seconds pass, then the values are back.
Given the overlay on screen, when the PC sleeps and wakes, or a monitor is turned off and on, then the overlay is still on screen and on top.
Given the overlay running for a minute at rest, when its cost is measured, then it is under 0.5 % of one core and 48 MB of private memory.
Given thermi installed, when `install.ps1 -Uninstall` finishes, then the service, the files and the sign-in entry are gone, and the settings stay.
